model_annotation: The diagram, labeled "Abbildung 4", represents the employment rates of women with a migration background across different age groups. The x-axis is labeled "Alter" (age) and ranges from 20 to 70 in intervals of 10, with a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "Anteil Erwerbstätigenquote in %" (percentage of employment rate) and spans from 0 to 100 in intervals of 20, also with a linear scale. The diagram contains three lines: a black line representing women without a migration background, a light gray line representing women who immigrated to Germany before 2009, and a blue line representing women who immigrated since 2010. The black line starts at around 60% at age 20, peaks at approximately 80% between ages 35-45, and then gradually declines to around 60% by age 60. The light gray line begins at roughly 40% at age 20, rises to about 60% between ages 35-45, and then decreases to around 40% by age 60. The blue line commences at approximately 30% at age 20, reaches a peak of around 50% between ages 35-40, and subsequently drops to about 25% by age 60.
